Interface NitriteExpressionHandler

All Known Implementing Classes:
CompileExpressionHandler, RuntimeExpressionHandler
@Internal public interface NitriteExpressionHandler
Strategy interface for handling expression resolution in Nitrite queries. Differentiates between compile-time literal inlining and runtime parameter binding.
Since:
5.2.0

    • handleRegex

      @Nullable @Nullable Object handleRegex(String fieldName, boolean ignoreCase, boolean negated, boolean startsWith, boolean endsWith, @Nullable @Nullable jakarta.persistence.criteria.Expression<?> rightExpression, boolean isLike, @Nullable @Nullable jakarta.persistence.criteria.Expression<Character> escapeExpression, NitriteQueryState queryState, io.micronaut.data.model.PersistentPropertyPath propertyPath)
      Handle a regex-based expression (Like, StartsWith, EndsWith, Contains).
      Parameters:
      fieldName - the field name
      ignoreCase - whether to ignore case
      negated - whether the expression is negated
      startsWith - whether it's a starts-with match
      endsWith - whether it's an ends-with match
      rightExpression - the right-hand side expression
      isLike - whether it's a LIKE expression (handling wildcards)
      escapeExpression - the LIKE escape character expression, if present
      queryState - the current query state
      propertyPath - the property path for the left-hand side
      Returns:
      the generated regex value or filter map
